text:
[LCMP.2.4.1] For each rule whose RHS has scope-activation facts
(an `emit` of a `scope activation` schema per [LSCP.3], or
continuations per [LCCO]), the compiler must emit:

- The list of activation-scoped facts (capture facts and emitted
  `scope activation` facts).
- The enumerated completion paths (synchronous RHS end, each
  `after` timer fire, each `on response` match, each
  `timeout` fire, each `error` match).
- The retract action emitted at each completion path.
